claims.statement: Management expects high single-digit volume growth in the band of 8 to 10 percent going forward.
claims.quote: we are still confident that demand conditions should continue giving us closer to high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8 -10%, as we predict going forward.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management intends to maintain its margin guidance of 18 to 20 percent.
claims.quote: We are maintaining our margin guidance, which is there.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Industrial coatings will continue to grow much higher than decorative coatings.
claims.quote: Industrial coatings will continue to grow much higher than decorative, given the investment happening in the infrastructure and Government spending that is happening in this area.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: International business is expected to continue to grow and contribute strongly.
claims.quote: International business again is expected to continue to grow and therefore, both industrial and international will strongly contribute to our growth going forward, as far as Q1 is concerned.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management plans to implement further price increases in the market.
claims.quote: We are looking at further price increases, which might happen in the market, as we go ahead.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: The company declared a final dividend of Rs. 23 per share, bringing the total dividend for the year to Rs. 27.5 per share with a payout ratio of about 60 percent.
facts.quote: The final dividend would be Rs. 23 per share, and there was an interim dividend which we had already declared at Rs. 4.5 per share. If we look at the total dividend for the year it becomes Rs. 27.5 per share, and the payout is about 60% ratio.

facts.statement: Gross margins reached an all-time high of about 45.6 percent due to market deflation across four quarters.
facts.quote: taking our Gross Margins to almost an all-time high of about 45.6%, which is very strong.

facts.statement: The company has already taken close to 10.5 to 11 percent in cumulative price increases.
facts.quote: where we have already taken close to about 10.5-11% price increase

facts.statement: Backward integration projects are scheduled to commence in the first half of the year.
facts.quote: commencement of your backward integration projects from 1Q or 1H, which you have called out now, is also quite timely.
